I replied to Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**, their Director of Yard Operations.

Dana's message in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 says Thea flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The public North cheat sheet also lists her as QFL's main contact. Marcus can see both, and a contact name is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share.
